The '''Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport''' ('''UT-AT'''), nicknamed the "'''Trident'''," was a type of [[repulsorcraft]] vehicle used by the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]], participating in the [[Mygeeto Campaign|assault on Mygeeto]] with the [[Galactic Marines|21st Nova Corps]] late in the [[Cloning|Clone]] Wars.

==Characteristics==
The Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport (UT-AT), nicknamed the "Trident,"<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was 23.8 [[meter]] long [[repulsorlift]] [[Repulsorcraft|vehicle]] that was manufactured by both [[Kuat Drive Yards]] and [[Mekuun Corporation]]. Created after Kuat Drive Yards' [[engineer]]s realized that quadripod [[walker]]s were not suitable for all types of terrain<ref name="French SWE" /> and once the [[Galactic Republic]] saw its ground forces needed a vehicle for unstable terrain,<ref name="History 58" /> Kuat Drive Yards' [[engineer]]s knew that Mekuun Corporation would take inspiration from other vehicles in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] and create what they needed. The UT-AT was equipped with a [[turbolaser]] [[cannon]] [[turret]], two side medium [[laser cannon]]s, a twin anti-[[infantry]] [[blaster]] below the vehicle's [[cockpit]], and four anti-infantry [[laser]] turrets. Some models of the UT-AT were also equipped with a generator that could launch [[ion grenade]]s out of four [[bomb]] launchers situated on the top of the vehicle.<ref name="French SWE" />

[[File:UT-AT.png|thumb|left|245px|An Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport from above.]]
The UT-AT consisted of two parallel rows of eight repulsors. These repulsors were connected to the main body of the vehicle by hinges and installed on hydraulic pads, allowing them to easily adapt to changes in terrain, lowering and tilting to optimize the efficiency of vehicle movement. Field [[sensor]]s and scanners were planced under the cabin, which ensured that the [[pilot]] and crew did not encounter surprises while on the move. The repulsors that propelled the vehicle were separate from the repulsors that adapted to the terrain. These repulsors were installed under the main body of the UT-AT and numbered four. This allowed the UT-AT to reach speeds of forty-five [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]].<ref name="French SWE" />

The UT-AT was also an extremely stable [[artillery]] platform due to the repulsor pads which allowed its heavy guns to fire without any difficulty. When positioned upside down, these repulsors would generate faxing fields on the ground. The UT-AT then anchored in the ground and became completely motionless, regardless of the nature of the terrain. This allowed the central turbolaser cannon and the lateral medium laser cannons to fire with extreme precision. It was precisely these three weapons that earned the model the nickname of "the Trident."<ref name="French SWE" />

The base model of the UT-AT was crewed by one pilot and five [[gunner]]s, and could transport twenty [[clone trooper]]s or engineers, which were situated at the front section of the vehicle that was also near the [[reactor]]. The cabin of the UT-AT was intended for two operators, a pilot and a gunner. The latter controlled the two medium guns and the anti-personnel guns. For the classic model, the anti-artillery guns and the anti-personnel guns, located at the rear, were handled by specialized gunners. Although the UT-AT appeared vulnerable when compared to heavier vehicles, it was a centerpiece of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="French SWE" />

==Role==
The UT-AT served as an artillery platform<ref name="French SWE" /> and frontline support.<ref name="ROTS" />

==History==
[[File:UTAT_Mygeeto.png|thumb|right|280px|The UT-AT was deployed to the planet Mygeeto, where the UT-AT found fame and effectiveness.]]
Following problems with the movement that several quadripod walkers had caused during the [[Clone Wars]], the Galactic Republic asked Kuat Drive Yards to build a new model that was more suitable and armed with laser cannons. Kuat approached Mekuun Corporation which had, among others, designed the [[High-Altitude Entry Transport-221]] and was known for its ability to build high performance military vehicles equipped with certain repulsors.<ref name="French SWE" /> The UT-AT was introduced into and saw use within the [[Clone Wars]], joining the fight on many battlefields and proving itself to be effective within them, although true notoriety eluded the vehicle. Late in the war<ref name="History 58" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> it saw use during the [[Mygeeto Campaign]], specifically the [[Fourth Battle of Mygeeto]],<ref name="ROTS" /> and [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia]]. The vehicle's service on the [[planet]]s of [[Cato Neimoidia]] and [[Mygeeto]] proved to be particularly noble and finally cemented its status as an effective weapon.<ref name="History 58" />

Additionally, at least one UT-AT saw use on the Separatist stronghold world of [[Murkhana]], where the Trident transport was destroyed and left abandoned for years to come alongside burnt out [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]]s, similarly damaged [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut|Juggernauts]], and Separatist equipment.<ref name="Tarkin">[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]</ref> On Mygeeto during its fourth battle, several participated in the battle with the [[Galactic Marines|21st Nova Corps]] led by [[Jedi General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Bacara]]. At least one was destroyed by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] [[Octuptarra tri-droid]]'s projectile during the engagement, causing it to explode and launch into the air.<ref name="ROTS" /> Following the implementation of [[Order 66]] and the execution of General Mundi, the 21st Nova Corps cleaned up the remaining pockets of Separatist resistance.<ref name="HC 15">{{HelmetCollectionCite|15|Helmets}}</ref> The UT-AT went on to serve in the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="French SWE" /> In [[14 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> the ruined UT-AT on Murkhana—still left a ruined husk of a world after the Clone War—was spotted by [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], who had arrived on Murkhana as part of the [[Berch Teller campaign|Berch Teller investigation]].<ref name="Tarkin" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport first appeared in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> and first identified in the [[canon]] ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> Previously, it had been identified in the novel ''[[Tarkin (novel)|Tarkin]]'' as the Trident.<ref name="Tarkin" /> In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], it was identified with its full name in the [[Databank (original)|original databank]].<ref name="OG databank">{{DB|vehicle|utat|Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport (UT-AT)}}</ref>
